Class CreateScenarioController

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.controller.CreateScenarioController
public class CreateScenarioController extends Object
Controller for the "Create Scenario" use case.

Manages the step-by-step creation of a new Scenario, including:

  1. Initializing with scenario period ticks.
  2. Selecting locomotive templates and setting their availability.
  3. Selecting cargo types and defining their behaviors.
  4. Configuring industry production frequency.
  5. Persisting the completed scenario.

Assumes the user is already authenticated and authorized to create scenarios.

    • startCreateScenario

      public void startCreateScenario(LocalDateTime triggerDate, int periodStart, int periodEnd)
      Begins a new scenario session.

      Creates a Scenario with the specified trigger date and period. Loads the current map for context.

      Parameters:
      triggerDate - date/time when the scenario will take effect
      periodStart - start tick of the scenario period
      periodEnd - end tick of the scenario period
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if triggerDate is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if periodStart > periodEnd
